info.title: F-Grade Corporate AI CRM API
info.description: Live Zoho CRM records and server-side metrics for the F-Grade Corporate AI Agent. Semantic concepts such as converted, conversion rate, revenue, pipeline, and top owner are business operations, not CRM field names.
info.x-copilot-studio-tool-description: Use this single tool for every CRM question. Send the user's complete natural-language question unchanged in question. The backend must re-analyze the current message before every request; use conversation_id only when the current message is a true follow-up. The backend owns module selection, module-specific field validation, filters, owner resolution, explicit DateTime boundaries, pagination, aggregation, ranking, conversion logic, query budgeting, and answer generation. For multi-module questions, the backend executes separate module-valid queries and combines the results. Never construct module names, field names, owner IDs, filters, COQL, date criteria, aggregate expressions, or conversion logic in Copilot Studio. Never send Deal fields such as Amount or Stage to Leads. Never emit a Leads field named Converted. Conversion questions must remain natural language and be handled by the backend.
info.x-copilot-studio-input-policy: question is required, must contain the user's complete natural-language CRM request, and may be up to 2000 characters. Send conversation_id only when available for the same conversation. Do not transform, shorten, summarize, or reinterpret the question. If the current message changes the CRM module or corrects the prior request, the backend must rebuild the request from the current intent and discard incompatible previous fields and filters.

post.description: Resolves record, count, aggregate, grouped, and lead-conversion questions and executes the required filtered Zoho CRM query or queries.

200.description: Complete answer and requested CRM data returned by the backend for the user's question.

400.description: Invalid question, field, date, owner, or aggregate request.

502.description: Zoho CRM configuration, authentication, or query failure.

AssistantRequest.description: Natural-language CRM question. Send the complete user request in question.

question.description: The complete natural-language CRM question provided by the user.

conversation_id.description: Optional stable conversation identifier used to resolve natural-language follow-up questions.

response.description: Complete answer and requested CRM data returned by the backend for the user's question.
Complete answer explaining why the backend could not answer the user's question.
